Name: MisoMegu's Nemuneko Plushies
Author: MisoMegu
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/IDAEpDK.png[/img]
[center][size=4]─── ⋆｡ﾟ☁︎｡⋆｡ ﾟ☾ ﾟ｡⋆ ───[/size][/center]
[center][size=4]Do you know the adorable pillow plushies called Nemuneko? Well now you can collect them in Stardew as well! There will be SO MANY in this mod so they needed their own! I plan to recreate all the ones I can find irl plus colorations to expand the collection even more! 
I of course had to sneak in some of my OCs into the mod. Some you'd know from my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20761]foxes[/url]﻿ mod and others that haven't been introduced yet ♥ 
The Nemuneko pillows will also be in my huge [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25442]plushie[/url]﻿ mod but that gets updated less frequently so keep this mod up to date if you want all of the types of neko  ﻿[/size][size=4]ᓚ₍ ^. .^₎[/size]

[size=4]Let me know if there is a specific Nemuneko that I haven't included that you want and I'll get it up asap![/size]
[size=4][img]https://stickershop.line-scdn.net/stickershop/v1/sticker/30971242/android/sticker.png[/img][/size]
[size=1]「[url=https://charahiroba.com/prize/original/?utm_campaign=nemuneko&utm_medium=g_twitter&utm_source=special]Nemuneko[/url]﻿ is a irl plushy by the FuRyu company」[/size][size=4]﻿[/size]

[size=4]─── ⋆｡ﾟ☁︎｡⋆｡ ﾟ☾ ﾟ｡⋆ ───

Compatible with 1.6
﻿Needs [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿
『Replaces the Lg. Junimo Plush and Lg. Futan Bear』
Not required but I absolutely recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23488]Precise Furniture[/url]﻿ to enjoy this mod to the fullest.
This is my 7th mod so of course as always, I am open to advice, suggestions, fixes, translations, or anything else!
I have not uploaded this mod anywhere else, so if you see it elsewhere it's been snagged without my permission!

If you enjoy my mods please endorse and track them and donate if you have some spare change ♥
